annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of the European Union (Presidency), General Secretariat
annotation.summary_en: Council Presidency note (5662/24) analysing and annexing the final compromise text of the EU AI Act agreed at the December 2023 trilogue. It sets a risk-based regime with prohibitions, high-risk requirements, GPAI model rules, an AI Office, sandboxes and penalties. Embodied AI is covered via product-safety integration (machinery, medical devices, vehicles).
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based tiers: prohibited practices (Art. 5), high-risk systems (Arts. 6-29a), transparency duties
High-risk AI as safety components of products under Annex II legislation (machinery, medical devices) uses existing conformity assessment
New GPAI model rules with 10^25 FLOPs systemic-risk threshold and codes of practice
AI Office, AI Board, scientific panel and advisory forum created; penalties up to EUR 35m or 7% turnover
Staged application: 6 months for prohibitions, 24 months general, 36 months for Annex II products
